posts.title: House of Huawei (Initial Thoughts)
posts.description: I'm currently reading through Eva Dou's House of Huawei, going back and forth between each chapter and the copious footnote material offered on the publisher's official website. Love the narrative, but I feel that some of the content is grasping to understand authoritarianism and Huawei's role within a rising China....
